Meet Dr. Pepple

Dr. Godwill T. Pepple, MNIS, is seeking to lead the NIS Rivers State Branch. He is dedicated to contributing his knowledge, skills and passion toward a branch that is respected, ethical and committed to excellence.

Read More
LEADERSHIP · EDUCATION · SERVICE

Professional Profile

Surv. Dr. Godwill Tamunobiekiri Pepple, MNIS

A registered surveyor, researcher and professional leader whose work brings together geomatics, land administration and service to the surveying profession. From branch leadership and national committee work to teaching and international paper presentations, his career reflects a sustained commitment to stronger institutions and a more capable profession.

A Blueprint for Progress

I envision an NIS Rivers that is technologically advanced, regionally respected, ethically driven, and committed to excellence in service delivery.

01

Technologically Advanced

A branch that embraces modern surveying technology and equips its members to lead with it.

02

Regionally Respected

A branch whose standards and voice carry weight across the region and the profession.

03

Ethically Driven

Practice and leadership grounded in integrity, transparency and accountability.

04

Excellence in Service

Better service to members, clients and the public the profession exists to serve.

My Commitment

I am dedicated to contributing my knowledge, skills and passion toward achieving this vision by promoting innovation, lifelong learning, professional integrity and collaboration.
